investigated.finding: Commercial/consumer policies have different scopes; current effective versions need clause-level archival review.

conceptInvestigations.result: Platform contract terms can be audited, but territorial division and global reach cannot be inferred from a handful of policies.
unblock: Freeze effective versions for specified product, customer type and jurisdiction.
Independently code clause categories and verify use/reach denominator; do not turn platform terms into national sovereignty borders.
